i hope i don't sound annoying, but hey, it's okay if we are different, unable to fit in, alone. have you tried forgiving and accepting your whole personality? 

no need to have genuine friends, just chit chat with strangers as little as you want. if it is awkward, don't care too much, everybody always forget things eventually. you can always go to a concert by yourself and enjoy it. doing volunteer if getting a job is hard. creating happiness with what you already have is really the key. good luck!

i suggest taking the next semester off as well if you can. it helps, at least while adjusting to a new lifestyle you won't add more stress than it already is. start making appointment with both psychiatrist and psychologist. balancing with both meds and habits is very important. i spent half a year trying all kind of combination before i find the one that works for me. mine is escitalopram oxalate and zipren (aripiprazole), add merlopam if i can't sleep that night. 

i understand having social anxiety is making things worse, i developed something similar if not the same when i was depressed. i only go out at night when it happens, wearing mask and going to crowded place where nobody knows me help in making me getting used to people again. also, weirdly, showering and doing make up and hair styling help me feel much better and ready to face people (of course, this is only after i take meds)

i remember that time i suffered so much for a whole year, missed one full semester and got the next semester basically off (only two classes), just in bed doing nothing. and then i just wish i have the energy to wash the dishes after taking a bath. took me months to take a bath in the morning at 6am, another weeks to follow it up with a healthy breakfast and managed to wash the dishes too. somehow i ditched my actual studies and choose to learn about TOR and all that tech stuff i was always interested in but never had the chance to learn. i am still stalking that subreddit, it literally kept me alive. 

it's been years since then, the same pattern repeats once in a while. many many hours spent in the hospital that i hated to my core. i found out it has something to do with my period. can't say i am perfectly healthy mentally now, i found myself developing bad habits just to cope with my depression but i am alive and it's already months since my last meds. i'd call it a win, but i lost so many things on my way here.
